name: @flesler/open-canvas
description: Generate Cursor canvases to HTML, PNG, PDF, and IDE-ready .canvas.tsx

scripts.build:cli: tsc -b tsconfig.cli.json --clean && tsc -b tsconfig.cli.json && find dist -name '*.d.ts' -delete
scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:types: npm run test:types:cli && npm run test:types:app
scripts.lint:full:silent: bin/parallel-run.sh --silent test:types:cli test:types:app lint:fix && echo LINT OK
scripts.example:screenshot: npm run build:cli && node dist/cli.js generate example/showcase.canvas.tsx --title 'Open Canvas — SDK Showcase' --formats png --theme light --width 1280 --height 900 && cp example/out/showcase.png docs/showcase-light.png && node dist/cli.js generate example/showcase.canvas.tsx --title 'Open Canvas — SDK Showcase' --formats png --theme dark --width 1280 --height 900 && cp example/out/showcase.png docs/showcase-dark.png
scripts.example:cursor: npm run build:cli && node dist/cli.js generate example/showcase.canvas.tsx --formats cursor
scripts.ci:local: npm run build:cli && npm run lint:full && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run test:smoke
